The '''1960–61 [[Eliteserien|Hovedserien]]''' was the 17th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]].

==Overview==
It was contested by 16 teams, and [[Fredrikstad FK|Fredrikstad]] won the championship, their second consecutive league title and ninth title overall.
